The Council Storage Vault in Hogan's Keep.
Storage
offers the ability to store items permanently in a secure location. Items dropped on the ground will disappear after a time, and can be picked up by other players.
There are four basic categories of storage.
Inventory Storage
Every character has access to a personal backpack storage. The capacity of this storage can be increased permanently by leveling up
Endurance
. Certain recipes and consumable items have the ability to temporarily increase Inventory Storage. Equipment can generate with treasure effects which increase Inventory Storage when equipped. Equipment can also be modified to have inventory-increasing pockets by crafting skills. Leveling up certain skills will also allow you to divide your inventory storage using
Inventory Folders
.
Temporary Methods of Increasing Inventory Storage.
Two generic treasures can be appear on equipment which grant bonuses to inventory if equipped. The first offers a
+1 inventory
bonus and can be found on equipment for all slots. The second is only found on Chest and Legs slot items, but offers between
+2 inventory
and
+8 inventory
depending on the level of the effect. This second treasure can also give gear the
Roomy
prefix.
Equipment designed for the Saddlebag slot can have a treasure which offers between
+1 inventory
and
+4 inventory
depending on the level of the effect.
The skills
Shamanic Infusion
and
Toolcrafting
each allow the crafting of belts which have increases to inventory slots as their default effect.
Pocket Expander Potion
, an item sometimes acquired when completing quests, grants a bonus of
+3 inventory slots for 60 minutes.
Words of Power
can be obtained which temporarily increase inventory. The lowest potential increase is
+10 inventory for 1 hour
while the highest is
+100 for 1 hour.
Equipment with unused Craft Points can be permanently improved to raise personal inventory (adding pockets).
Blacksmithing
allows pockets to be added to Metal and Organic armor, while pockets on Leather and Cloth armor are added by
Tailoring
. Established adventurers are known to commission full sets of "pocket gear" from others with high-level crafting skills.
Council Vault Storage
Hulon
offers expandable storage through the
Council Storage
Machine system. Additional vault storage slots can be bought at increasing prices. Prices increase rapidly.
Slot 25 costs 900 Councils.
Slot 49 costs 8000 Councils.
Slot 62 costs 20,000 Councils.
Slot 63 costs 25,000 Councils.
Slots above 63 increase by 5,000 each time. Slots 81, the final slot, costs 115,000 Councils.
This storage is shared across and can be accessed from multiple zones.
In
Serbule
, the vault is accessed through
Hulon
in the town of
Serbule Keep
.
In
Eltibule
, a Council Vault is accessed through the Dilapidated Council Storage Machine in the courtyard of
Hogan's Keep
.
In
Kur Mountains
, a Council Storage Machine can be found at
Gloria Stonecurl
's home.
In
Rahu
, A Council Storage Machine can be found in the peaceful part of town, under a balcony near a Meditation Pillar.
NPC Storage
Several NPCs offer personal storage that scales depending on your favor level with them. Sometimes, these NPCs have restrictions on the items they will let you store.
Once you unlock your first NPC Storage or Chest Storage in a zone, you will be able to access that storage both through other NPCs that offer storage in the zone, and at specific intractable items.
In
Serbule
, a bookshelf in the building next to
Hulon
's shop.
In
Serbule Hills
, a bookshelf in the
Tapestry Inn
.
In
Kur Mountains
, a table near
Nightshade
.
In
Rahu
, a table near
Ichin the Ice Master
.
Chest Storage
Usable chests can be found throughout the world. These chests are often discovered through exploration, raising favor with NPCs,  or the completion of puzzles.  An early example is a chest found on
Anagoge
.
Special storage systems can also be used under certain circumstances.
Account Storage - Transfer Chests
Transfer Chests allow storing and retrieving items between characters on the same account. Currently, four chests exist. They can be found in:
Hulon
's shop in
Serbule
Next to the council storage machine in
Rahu
In
Sun Vale
, next to the guild storage in
Animal Town
.
Qatik
's room in the
Red Wing Casino
Guild Storage
Players who have joined a guild may have access to Guild Storage chests. This access is dependent on their guild-rank  and the access-rights set by the guild master.
There are guild chests in
Serbule
(2x),
Animal Town
,
Kur Mountains
,
Rahu
(2x) and in the
Red Wing Casino
(2x).
Ursula Storage
While under the effects of the
Haunted
curse, one variant of Ursula that may be spawned offers 16 storage slots.
Carpentry Storage
Adventurers with some knowledge of
Carpentry
can craft a range of Storage Crates that allow for a special storage space to be accessed.
Each player that access a storage crate can store their own items. All storage crates allow access to the same items for a player.
Shoddy Storage Crate
- A small box for storing up to 4 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed.
Crude Storage Crate
- A box for storing up to 8 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed.
Decent Storage Crate
- A box for storing up to 12 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed.
Nice Storage Crate
- A box for storing up to 16 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed.
Quality Storage Crate
- A box for storing up to 20 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed.
Great Storage Crate
- A box for storing up to 24 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed.
Amazing Storage Crate
- A box for storing up to 28 items. Lasts for 5 minutes once deployed.
Druid Storage
Druid storage is available as an unlock with Dreva's Blessings.  This storage has no cost or cooldown, but can only be used 1 hour before or after a druid event.  12 and 20 slot storages are available.
Lycanthropy Storage - Altar of Norala
Lycanthropes
may unlock storage at the
Altar of Norala
in the
Wolf Cave
.  Up to 48 slots may be unlocked by spending tokens during a Full Moon.
Warden Storage
Wardens
have access to a special storage chest in the
Sacred Grotto
(also accessible from any Kur storage access point). The number of slots increases as the player gains favor with the NPCs in the Grotto.  132 storage is available at max favor.
Fae Pocket Dimension
Fairies
learn to access special storage via the
Fae (Race Skill)
(10 slots at level 23 Fae (Race Skill), 20 slots at level 33, and 30 slots at level 47). This storage behaves similarly to a storage crate. Like most Fae (Race Skills), accessing the storage costs
Crystal Ice
and
Fairy Dust
.
Ri-Shin Shrine Storage
Each
Winter Holiday
, adventurers of Alharth have the chance to donate items at a Shrine of
Ri-Shin
in southern
Kur Mountains
. If unlocked, this storage chest grants everyone in-game storage slots based on the shrine's level. The lower tier of storage is 25 slots, the higher tier is 50.
Vendor Fox in a Box, Small Box of Space
Skills that may be learned by bartering
Live Event Credits
with
Riston
.
Once you learn the Vendor Fox in a Box ability, the ability requires you to have some type of crate in your inventory. Any crafted storage crate and most pet crates (when Animal Husbandry is released) will work to allow use of the ability. The crate will not be consumed. The cool down timer on the ability will reset in 2 real-time hours, but you still need to spend 2 hours in-game before you can use the ability again. (You can see that timer in your effects bar under the effect 'Boxed Fox'.)
Once you learn the Small Box of Space ability, there are no other requirements. Just use the ability to summon your storage box. The cool down timer for this ability is 90 minutes. The cool down timer on the ability will reset in 90 real-time minutes, but you still need to spend 90 in-game before you can use the ability again. (You can see that timer in your effects bar under the effect 'Spaced Out'.)
Cargo Suits
Through
Tailoring
, equipment with large amounts of inventory space but no treasure effects can be crafted. These
Cargo Suits
are intended for alt characters.
Finding Stored Items
isearch
The
/isearch
command searches all storage a players has access to, except for Guild Storage and Transfer Chests.
/isearch Salt
command will return a list of locations and quantities of all items in storage with "Salt" in the name.
Salt
and
Saltpeter
will both appear in the generated list.
/isearch +Salt
command will search for the exact word(s) entered. Only
Salt
will be displayed.
Inventory Search
Clicking on a magnifying glass icon at the bottom of the inventory window will allow you to use the isearch system without entering a command.
Practical Summoning
A technique for summoning items from nearby storage into inventory, this system becomes accessible once unlocked through the
Teleportation
skill. Items held in storage in the same zone as the crafter can be summoned directly to be used in crafting.
It is not possible to use
Practical Summoning
to retrieve items from  Council Vault Storage or Guild Storage Chests.
Stow Items in Nearby Storages
Completing
Wintria Irasce
's quest
Care Package from Rahu
unlocks the
Stow Items in Nearby Storages'
button. Pressing this button will move items from your inventory into any nearby storage, provided there is at least once of that item in the storage already.

Once you learn the Vendor Fox in a Box ability, the ability requires you to have some type of crate in your inventory. Any crafted storage crate and most pet crates (when Animal Husbandry is released) will work to allow use of the ability. The crate will not be consumed. The cool down timer on the ability will reset in 2 real-time hours, but you still need to spend 2 hours in-game before you can use the ability again. (You can see that timer in your effects bar under the effect 'Boxed Fox'.)

Once you learn the Small Box of Space ability, there are no other requirements. Just use the ability to summon your storage box. The cool down timer for this ability is 90 minutes. The cool down timer on the ability will reset in 90 real-time minutes, but you still need to spend 90 in-game before you can use the ability again. (You can see that timer in your effects bar under the effect 'Spaced Out'.)
/isearch Saltcommand will return a list of locations and quantities of all items in storage with "Salt" in the name.SaltandSaltpeterwill both appear in the generated list.
/isearch +Saltcommand will search for the exact word(s) entered. OnlySaltwill be displayed.
AStorage Chestin the Old Town district gains storage space when nightly Povus town quests are completed. This chest has a maximum of 80 slots.
Each quest completed will reward you 1 experience, bonus or regular nights.  Every 5 slots will increase the cost per slot.  SeeXptables/PovusStoragefor the total costs.
